title: Rest day. Keeping emotions in check

observed_trades.setup: Shorted Nebius early in the day into the 50-day as the market started to roll over (short a broken chart snapping back into supply).
observed_trades.entry_basis: short against the 50 simple moving average as it started to roll over early in the day
observed_trades.quote: The short that I tried, and shoot me now, was Nebius against the 50 simple moving average. Early in the day
observed_trades.notes: 'Early in the day'; one of the two shorts he took today. Stopped out the same day (next row).

observed_trades.setup: The short bounced, showed relative strength and tapped a new intraday high, stopping him out 13 cents from the high of day (227.99) before it rolled over into the close.
observed_trades.stop: stop was the intraday high; says he should probably have used the prior day high
observed_trades.quote: I'm getting stopped out. Oh, I don't know. Um 227.86.
observed_trades.notes: Ticker named at 00:50-01:03. Later calls it 'the way I covered my Nevius' (07:11) and 'I top-ticked Nebius' (14:37).

observed_trades.setup: Shorted more AXTI after a 100%+ V-shaped bounce back over the 50-day; it meandered then rolled over into the close and was lower after hours.
observed_trades.entry_basis: short into the 100% bounce back into supply at the 50-day
observed_trades.stop: 50-day as the guide on the entirety of the remaining shares
observed_trades.size: already had 2,200 shares short from June
observed_trades.quote: I ended up taking some AXTI uh today, and this one's trading down a bit lower
observed_trades.notes: Adds to an existing short ('now I get short again'; 'I still had 2,200 shares in that bounce', 09:50-10:03). 62 after hours is a quote, not a fill. Plans to cover a piece tomorrow.

observed_trades.setup: Core AXTI short from June 2nd that he is still holding part of.
observed_trades.quote: I'm still sitting on a $119 cost basis from June 2nd.
observed_trades.notes: Ticker named at 02:38. Later says 'a $120 cost basis' (10:03). Partly covered since (next row).

observed_trades.setup: Partial covers of the June 2nd short on the way down, the lowest in the 50s; 2,200 shares were still held through the bounce.
observed_trades.quote: And my lowest covers on this were in the 50s.
observed_trades.notes: No dates and no exact price ('in the 50s'). Ticker named at 02:38.
